title: Blush Framework relation
description: A relationship between entries: one type's entries filed under another's terms, or linked to other entries. It's named after its file.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file with.

id.description: The relation's id, written when it's saved.

kind.description: classify files entries under terms (named after the terms' type); reference links entries to other entries.

from.description: The types whose entries make the link; left out, every type.

to.description: The types linked to. A classify relation's is [its name].

field.description: The front matter key it's written under; its name by default.

label.description: What the admin and templates call it, such as Cast.

singular.description: What one target is called, such as Cook; made from the label by default.

multiple.description: Whether an entry may link to several.

ordered.description: Whether the order they're written in matters.

min.description: The fewest an entry needs to be published.

max.description: The most an entry may have to be published.

create.description: Whether writers may add a target as they type it in the admin.

symmetric.description: Whether a link counts from both ends (from and to the same types).

translations.description: A translation's links: fallback (its own, else its original's), add (both), or own.

control.description: How the admin's editor picks targets; left out, by its shape.

defaults.description: Values written into a new entry.

inverse.description: The targets' side; false for none.

label.description: What the list is called there, such as Acted in.

page.description: Whether each target's own page lists what links to it (on for terms and credits).

archive.description: A word for archives under each linking type's address (/movies/directors/penny), or false for none.

types.description: The types a target's page lists; left out, the relation's from.

max.description: The most entries that may link to one target.

listing.description: How a target's page lists them, with a type's listing keys (order, perPage).
